'''Kylo Batta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] famed for their career as a [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]]. While residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], Batta and a [[Kaori Batta's mother|noblewoman]] had a [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] named [[Kaori Batta|Kaori]], who grew up during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Kaori desired to match Kylo's reputation, so he avoided recruitment by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and eventually became a renowned [[Species/Legends|beast]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] like his [[Parent/Legends|father]].<ref name="Wretched Hives" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kylo Batta was mentioned in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'' by [[Paul Danner]], a [[1997]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Wretched Hives" />
